summary.text: Grant Miller (listed by Ballotpedia as Grant Amjad Miller) is a Democratic state representative from Utah House of Representatives District 24 who took office on January 1, 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Grant Amjad Miller earned a high school diploma from Jordan High School, an associate degree from Snow College in 2011, and a law degree from the University of Utah's S.J. Quinney College of Law in 2017, according to Ballotpedia.
He succeeded Joel Briscoe as the representative for District 24.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Miller said he is the first Palestinian-American elected official in Utah and a public defender whose career has been dedicated to the underserved.
He said his key campaign messages concern trans rights and reproductive healthcare, homelessness, and criminal justice reform.
Among legislation he said he passed were a bill reforming how defendants can pay court fines and a bill standardizing sentencing guidelines, and he said he introduced a "Homeless Bill of Rights."
